note: OPTIONAL top-level 'use' block on any item manifest: what the item does when the player uses it from the toolbar. Data-driven so a mod can give its own items behaviour without code. Today only use.right_click is read, by the runtime PlantingController.

right_click.note: Action fired when the item is the ACTIVE toolbar slot and the player right-clicks (a click, not a right-drag - dragging pans the camera).

action.note: 'plant_growth_group': right-click the ground to plant the named growth group at stage 1, consuming one of the item. The spot is checked against the group's growth.rules first (see growth_group.schema.json): valid biome, allowed season, temperature range, not water, not too steep, within reach, not on top of another plant. An unknown action is ignored.

group.note: Id of the growth group to plant (e.g. 'wheat', 'oak'). Must be a tree or crop group. Looked up in the item's own mod namespace first, then any loaded mod. If no loaded mod provides it the player is told the group is not installed.
